name: Qwen3.5-Omni-Flash
access: QwenCloud API (qwen3.5-omni-flash over HTTP, qwen3.5-omni-flash-realtime over WebSocket)

voice.input_audio: Realtime API: PCM 16-bit mono at 16 kHz by default (8, 24 or 48 kHz and WAV can be set), images as JPG frames about 1 per second; HTTP API: audio files or Base64 data in a message [qwencloud-rt-guide] [qwencloud-omni-guide]
voice.output_audio: Realtime API: PCM 16-bit mono at 24 kHz by default (8, 16 or 48 kHz and WAV can be set); HTTP API: wav only, as Base64 fragments in the stream [qwencloud-rt-guide] [qwencloud-omni-guide]
voice.voices: 55 preset voices (47 multilingual and 8 dialectal; default Tina) and cloned voices made from an audio sample on both APIs [qwencloud-rt-guide] [qwencloud-voice-cloning]
languages: Realtime: speech recognition in 113 languages and dialects, speech output in 36
HTTP guide: speech output in 29 languages and 7 Chinese dialects, input in 74 languages and 39 dialects (the counts differ by page)
voice.turn_detection: Realtime API only: server_vad (default) or semantic_vad, which the guide recommends for this model; threshold default 0.5, silence_duration_ms default 800 (range 200 to 6000); idle_timeout_ms 5000 to 30000 in server_vad mode makes the model prompt a silent user; turn_detection null selects manual commit [qwencloud-client-events] [qwencloud-rt-guide]
voice.interruption: Realtime API: semantic interruption tells a real attempt to take the floor from a backchannel or background noise; the server sends speech_started when the user starts to speak, and the client must clear its playback buffer; voice commands change volume, speed and emotion; the HTTP API has no barge-in [qwencloud-rt-guide] [arxiv-qwen3-5-omni]
voice.latency: Technical report, first-packet latency at one concurrent request in an internal set-up: 235 ms for audio input and 426 ms for video input on the Flash model [arxiv-qwen3-5-omni]; Artificial Analysis measured an average time to first audio of 0.79 seconds for the realtime Flash model on its Big Bench Audio set [aa-s2s]
voice.session_limit: Realtime API: 120 minutes per WebSocket session; retained history of 80 audio turns or 480 seconds of audio and 50 video turns or 120 seconds of video [qwencloud-rt-guide]

pricing_usd_per_mtok.notes: QwenCloud model page (read 2026-10-03), by modality: text, image and video input US$0.40; audio input US$3.00; text output US$2.20; output that includes audio US$11.90 (text output is then not charged); Artificial Analysis lists 0.10 input and 0.80 output, which does not match the QwenCloud page; the page shows no cache price; the realtime model qwen3.5-omni-flash-realtime has its own page rates per million tokens: audio input US$4.5, text, image and video input US$0.55, text output US$3.3, text and audio output US$17.7 (output text then not charged); Artificial Analysis lists US$0.162 per hour of input audio and US$0.816 per hour of output audio for it, which does not match the page [qwencloud-page-35flash-rt] [aa-s2s]
